input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4 gives Customer a convenience right on one month's notice (consistent with our 30-day position) and IBM has no convenience right, but the right is conditioned on uncapped, externally-specified early termination charges and the Agreement provides no refund of prepaid charges (§ 3.5 only accelerates Customer's payment obligations). Our preferred position is convenience termination without penalty plus a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, so we deleted the open-ended charges and added the refund; the fallback of a cap at three months' charges is offered in the comment.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying all charges accrued for Services provided through the effective date of termination, in which case IBM will refund any prepaid charges for the period after the effective date of termination on a pro-rata basis and no early termination charges or other penalty will be payable by Customer.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have removed the open-ended early termination charges and added a pro-rata refund of prepaid charges, so our convenience right on one month's notice is exercisable without penalty. If IBM needs some recovery, we can accept a cap on early termination charges not exceeding three (3) months' charges for the terminated Service Option Attachment.
proposal.summary: Delete uncapped early termination charges and add pro-rata refund of prepaid fees on Customer convenience termination.
